Volunteer sign-up

Riverside Community Garden welcomes volunteers of all ages and abilities. No experience is needed: our session leaders will show you what to do and how to do it safely.
Sessions run every Saturday morning from 9 to 12. Tools and gloves are provided; please wear closed shoes and bring a bottle of water.

Sign up

Fill in the form below. We will email you the date of the next session within two days.

What should I expect?

Most sessions involve weeding, watering and mulching. Children are welcome when accompanied by an adult, and we stop for tea at half past ten.
Riverside Community Garden is a registered charity. Questions? Write to hello@riverside.example or call 020 7946 0000.
